psychological_meaning: Tall Poppy evokes a sense of energy, passion, and boldness. It is a color that commands attention and can symbolize courage, strength, and a zest for life. This shade of red, softened with hints of brown, creates a feeling of warmth and groundedness, balancing the intensity with a touch of sophistication.
